title: Sevilla historical tour.
text:
Fantastic way to experience a whirlwind few hours to see the main highlights of Sevilla’s history and cultural centre.
Juan our guide was excellent and extremely knowledgeable.
What was supposed to be a 2 hour walking tour, ended up being 3.5 hours, as Juan was keen for us to see as much of Sevilla as possible.
Could tell he was proud of the city he lives in, and justifiably so.
Gracias Juan for an enjoyable walking tour.
author: Clwydwyn_E

title: Great overview of the city!
text: Very comprehensive tour of the city covering all the major points of interest. Lots of walking, but they go at a comfortable pace always offering opportunities to rest, if needed.
author: Michelle_R

title: A five star walking tour…
text: An exceptionally good walking tour.  Miguel clearly loves his city of Seville and seems to know it inside and out.  I learnt so much about the architecture, the history, the myths and all about Don Juan.  It was a pleasure to spend almost 3 hours with Miguel. Highly recommend this tour…
author: Carolyn_P

title: Amazing Tour of Sevilla
text: Our tour was amazing. The Tour Guide was super knowledgeable and could tell exactly what we wanted to see. He took us all around the city, giving us history lessons while showing us all of the important sites. He seem to really enjoy his job and loved entertaining us. We were with him for more than three hours in Seville and could not have been happier. We learned so much from him.
author: Jill_M

title: Seville private tour
text: Francisco is a great guide. Local and has all the knowledge of Seville. Very accommodating and spoke great English. Went over our contracted time with no issue or pressure to finish. Great private tour.
author: ChristianampErika_E

title: Walking Tour of Seville
text: Our guide was wonderful! He shared stories about the history of Seville and brought the city to life. The tour runs longer than the allotted time, so keep that in mind when booking. Highly recommend and do a walking tour at the start of your trip.
author: Lynne_L

title: A city walk full of stories and hidden pearls
text: We had a lovely walk around the historic district. 3 super nice hours where we got around, with lots of good and interesting stories.
author: Lene_H

title: Perfect walking tour of Seville!
text: Really amazing introduction to this beautiful city! Francisco was a wonderful guide who gave us the history and interesting information in such a friendly manner, making sure we saw all the main highlights as well as showing us in detail on the map lots of his favourite recommendations. Highly recommend this brilliant tour to get your bearings and get all the main highlights during your stay! Thank you Francisco!
author: Natalie_P

title: Absolutely Worth It!
text:
This tour is a great introduction to Seville and helps you get oriented in the city. There are maps available in the office (meeting place) and your guide can show you where you’ll be going, as well as suggest places to visit on your own. 
My guide was friendly, personable and knowledgeable about the history of Seville and the places we visited. He made sure I was aware of opportunities to use a restroom (difficult to find public restrooms here). He brought some snacks to share; we also stopped at an upscale candy store where I bought seeds and sampled a chocolate. 
The tour is 3 hours and you
author: Janet_D
